_comment: All figures are absolute USD per million tokens, transcribed from the official
price sheet. Cache columns are stored absolutely rather than as multipliers so
that per-model exceptions (Fable/Mythos 5.1 cache reads) need no special case.
Model IDs marked inferred:true were not observed in a real transcript; matching
is most-specific-prefix-wins, so dated suffixes and [1m] resolve to these entries.

batch.note: Claude Code never batches; present for completeness. Not combinable with fast mode.

inference_geo_us.note: Claude 4.6 and later only. usage.inference_geo == 'us'. Absent, null, 'global' or 'not_available' => 1.0.

note: speed=='fast' swaps the base input/output pair and cache columns are recomputed
from the fast base (1.25x / 2x / 0.1x). On Opus 4.6 a fast request runs at standard
speed and bills at STANDARD rates - do not apply the fast pair. On Opus 4.7 the
request errors, so a fast record should never exist; warn if one is seen.
Fast mode is first-party API only and cannot combine with batch.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.note: Cache reads are 0.025x base input, not the usual 0.1x.

models.name: Claude Mythos 5.1
models.note: Limited availability. Cache reads are 0.025x base input.

models.name: Claude Fable 5
models.note: Differs from 5.1 ONLY in cache reads ($1 vs $0.25). Prefix matching must not collapse these.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.6
models.note: speed=='fast' runs at standard speed and bills at these standard rates.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.1
models.note: Retired on first-party; still billable on Bedrock and Google Cloud.

models.name: Claude Opus 4
models.note: Retired on first-party; still billable on Google Cloud.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5
models.note: The $2/$10 introductory rate became the standard price; the scheduled rise to $3/$15 on 2026-09-01 did not happen.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.note: 50% more expensive than Sonnet 5. The prefix-matching trap - regression test required.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.note: Observed locally as claude-haiku-4-5-20251001; must resolve to this undated entry.

web_search.note: $10 per 1,000 searches. Errored searches are not billed, but the transcript does not distinguish them - treat the count as an upper bound.

web_fetch.note: No charge beyond the token cost of fetched content. Parse for --verbose only.

tokenizer_note: Claude 4.7 and later use a tokenizer producing roughly 30% more tokens for the same text. This does not affect cost math (actual tokens are counted) but makes raw token counts non-comparable across model generations. Worth a README line.
